instructions: Control the devices selected by the local nb1 daemon. Preview is optional. run_light validates and submits one Action, Sequence, saved pattern_id or trigger without a preceding preview. Omit serial to use routing on a daemon that supports it. Playback tools require a daemon with Playback policy support. Playback policy is shared across HTTP, MCP and managed CLI requests; get_playback_status explains the current decision and list_playback_requests shows bounded in-memory policy history. A suppress override rejects new playback; permit overrides the persistent policy until expiry. The daemon reloads its configured Playback mode, timezone, weekly windows and history limit on restart. Temporary overrides and request history are cleared. {{transport}} Foreground CLI direct Jobs are separate process-local work and cannot be queried through these HTTP tools.
stdio_instructions: This stdio adapter selects its local HTTP endpoint with --endpoint (default {{default_endpoint}}). Use --token-file for an authenticated loopback API. It does not read nb1 YAML, open USB, or execute the CLI.
http_instructions: This remote service uses Streamable HTTP.

tool_descriptions.list_devices: List the devices configured in the local daemon and their cached state.
tool_descriptions.get_playback_status: Read the daemon's effective Playback policy and current temporary override.
tool_descriptions.list_playback_requests: Read recent in-memory Playback policy decisions without request bodies or user content.
tool_descriptions.set_playback_override: Temporarily suppress or permit new playback requests for a bounded duration. A new override replaces the previous one.
tool_descriptions.clear_playback_override: Remove the temporary Playback override and return to the configured policy.
tool_descriptions.get_device_state: Read a device's cached RGB observation and sampled_at timestamp.
tool_descriptions.resolve_color: Resolve a hex color, name, RGB8/HSV object or @local-name through the daemon. Returns an exact lowercase Hex6 color.
tool_descriptions.preview_light: Preview exactly one Action, Sequence or saved pattern_id. Returns the normalized Sequence, duration, step count and device capability check. Optional serial selects a cached device profile.
tool_descriptions.run_light: Submit exactly one Action, Sequence, saved pattern_id or trigger once. Set serial for a specific device. Omit serial to use routing on a daemon that supports it. Preserve the returned Job ID and endpoint and use get_job after an unknown outcome.
tool_descriptions.get_job: Read the original Job by ID. Missing records may have expired or belong to an earlier daemon lifetime.
tool_descriptions.cancel_job: Request cancellation of a Job by ID. Include the accepted serial to require device matching on a daemon that supports guarded cancellation. A cancelling result requires get_job polling until cleanup reaches a terminal state.
tool_descriptions.list_colors: List locally saved color names and exact lowercase Hex6 values.
tool_descriptions.save_color: Resolve and save a local named color. Names start with a lowercase letter and contain up to 32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens. Existing names are replaced.
tool_descriptions.list_patterns: List locally saved Pattern ID and title summaries.
tool_descriptions.get_pattern: Read a local Pattern's ID, optional title and frozen Sequence.
tool_descriptions.save_pattern: Compile and save one Action or Sequence as a local Pattern. Optional title accepts up to 256 Unicode characters. The saved Pattern fixes resolved RGB values. Existing IDs are replaced.

schema_descriptions.color_string: Hex3, Hex6, CSS color name or @local-name.
schema_descriptions.color_hsv: HSV decimals allow at most six fractional digits. The daemon resolves exact RGB without implicit gamma.
schema_descriptions.job_id: Omit or use an empty string to generate j_ plus ten Crockford Base32 characters.
schema_descriptions.job_policy: Busy-device policy. The default is reject. queue waits in order. preempt cancels the active Job on the selected device and runs next, preserving waiting Jobs.
schema_descriptions.action_period_ms: The compiler validates the full cycle against step, timing and duration limits.
schema_descriptions.sequence: At most 1024 executed Steps including repeat and 24 hours nominal duration. Interval Steps retain initial LED order and use fade_ms <= interval_ms.
